text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A Malaysian company G-Two Holdings and the Malawi Development Corporation (MDC) on Tuesday signed an agreement to build a more than 150-roomed $20-million hotel in Blantyre.
- Malawi President Bakili Muluzi said on Tuesday that his predecessor Kamuzu Banda was the most corrupt leader in Africa.
- Malawi's Labour movement believes that half of the 35-strong cabinet misleads President Bakili Muluzi which fuels the country's rampant corruption.
